response.integration_next_step: Resolve the open Critical security finding, complete Chinese counsel review, verify China business entity/invoice capability, and obtain pricing approval before attempting any pilot integration.

competitive_choices.prompt_content_safety: AI firewalls and content guardrails (e.g., Llama Guard, NeMo Guardrails, Azure AI Content Safety)
